name: git branch
purpose: List local branches or create a new branch.
explanation: Shows all local branches (marking the active branch with `*`) or creates a new branch pointer without switching to it yet.

parameters.description: Optional name of a new branch to create.

explanationOfOutput: Lists branches; `*` marks the currently checked-out branch (`main`).

beforeAfterState.after: New branch `feature-login` created pointing to current commit; `HEAD` remains on `main`.

whenToUse: To inspect existing branches or create a branch before switching.
commonMistakes: Assuming `git branch <name>` automatically switches you onto the new branch (use `git checkout -b` or `git switch -c` to create AND switch).
